# `ext::cbor_stream` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/cbor_stream.lani#L8)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Allocating streaming RFC 8949 codec over ext::cbor events: a chunk-fed Decoder (sticky typed errors with u64 offsets, depth/item/string/input limits, CBOR sequences), EventReader over core::io::Read, and a buffered Writer with flush_to core::io::Write. Optional core deterministic mode (section 4.2.1) rejects or produces non-preferred heads, indefinite lengths, non-shortest floats and unsorted or duplicate keys. Native Linux x86_64 binaries agree with all 81 hand-typed Appendix A rows and an independent Python implementation on 1,500 generated, 3,000 mutated, 2,400 limit and 1,200 sequence cases at four chunk sizes; the cbor-to-json sample agrees on 700 cases. The cargo registrations were not run in this session.
